'''Toryn Farr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a chief communications officer in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], she was stationed in [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

==Biography==
Toryn Farr and her sister [[Samoc Farr/Legends|Samoc]] were raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] within a [[Farr family|family]] that was loyal to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. Opposed to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Farr's family enlisted the help of Chandrilan authorities and staged a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] crash, in which a number of children were supposedly killed, including the Farr sisters. The [[Gender/Legends|girls]] were taken offworld and they joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. Farr's sister, Samoc, became a skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and the two were stationed in [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> As Chief Controller of Echo Command, Farr's primary duties included monitoring [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and relaying orders to [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and vessels in the field.

[[File:Toryn-farr.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Toryn in the command center of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].]]
During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], she commanded the base's [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|ion cannon]] when to fire on Imperial [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Most notably, she gave the command which disabled the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']], allowing the first [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]], the [[Quantum Storm/Legends|''Quantum Storm'']], to escape through the blockade, which served as the opening shots of the engagement.

Toryn was among the last Rebels to abandon Echo Base, leaving her station only after [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] ordered the final evacuation. After broadcasting the evacuation code signal to the surviving soldiers and pilots still engaging the Imperial assault force, she was the final person to leave the command center. Toryn escaped on the last transport to leave Hoth, the [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']].

Prior to boarding the transport, Toryn was stunned to see a large number of badly wounded soldiers still lying on the flight deck before the ship. Among the wounded was her sister, Samoc Farr, a talented [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] pilot. Knowing her sister had been shot down led her to the realization of how truly horrific the battle outside had been.

Toryn was instrumental in buying the wounded just enough time to board the transport before invading [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] descended on the hangar. However, the time it took to load all the wounded onto the ship would prove to be the undoing of the ''Bright Hope'', as it was quickly disabled during its blockade run before being able to make the jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

Crippled and drifting through space with little hope of escape, Toryn assumed command of the survivors and implemented a plan to save as many Rebel lives as possible. Three [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] holding eighteen of the most valuable personnel to the Rebel cause were launched back to Hoth, in the hopes they might survive.

[[File:Of_Possible_Futures.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Farr and the bounty hunters]]
Before the Imperials were able to capture the survivors of the ''Bright Hope'', the ship was boarded by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]]. They masqueraded as rescuers, when they were actually responsible for firing on the ''Bright Hope'' and preventing its escape. The truth behind their facade was to take the Rebels and use them as bait to capture Han Solo, and later, turn him in to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

Following a brief melee, Toryn convinced the bounty hunters to take all ninety remaining Rebels on board and deliver them to the Rebel underground on [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]]. Before evacuating the ship, she dutifully erased all [[Computer/Legends|computer]] records on board, preventing vital information from falling into Imperial hands, including the names of many personnel who served at Echo Base.

After spending a month on Darlyn Boda following her escape from Hoth, Toryn finally rejoined the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]] at the secret [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]]. For her brave efforts in assuming command to rescue the survivors of the ''Bright Hope'', she was promoted to the rank of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in a ceremony led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']].

She was also given command of a group of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], with her first mission being to rescue the eighteen members of the ''Bright Hope'' who were jettisoned back to Hoth.

==Behind the scenes==
Toryn Farr was played by [[Brigitte Kahn]]. A woman who looks similar in appearance to Farr is featured in ''[[A New Beginning]]'', but there was no indication that this particular controller was the same character.

Farr introduced the Raid Battles during the limited-time Operation Hoth Defensive Event in the [[2013]] card game app ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''. She was assigned [[Grond (Rebel)|Grond's]] line. The Event was optional for players.
